broadcasts.message: normalize.js implemented: NFKC normalize, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No word alteration. Ready for integration.
tokenizer.js ready: tokenize(text) normalizes then extracts alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order. No stopwords, no negation removal. Ready to integrate with pipeline.
Pipeline implemented. Uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to safely handle tokens like 'constructor'. Returns exact shape. Ready for integration.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: My task is normalize.js. Spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. No word addition/drop/reorder. Handle string input. Ensure no shadowing of injected normalize/tokenize. Next: implement and broadcast. Later rounds may adjust based on peer feedback but must remain faithful.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Starting tokenizer.js. Implement tokenize(text) exactly per spec: call injected normalize(text), then regex [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*, return array. No shadowing. Keep tokens in order, no stopwords. Will verify with peers later.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I own pipeline.js. Interface: processText(text) -> {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Dependencies: tokenize(text) injected. Must handle prototype names (constructor, etc.). Use Object.create(null) for frequencies. Tokens are from tokenizer; text is tokens.join(' ').
